title: Add section about chained methods not being new methods
description:
## Summary

Add a dedicated section (or callout box) explaining that chaining/combining existing methods together doesn't constitute a new method - it's simply a pipeline/workflow.

## Examples to reference

### Existing content (PCR example)
In `too-many-pca.qmd` (lines 247-250):
> Principal Component Regression (PCR) is a term for such a scenario. It is a model that applies PCA to the predictors before passing them to a linear regression model. However we don't treat PCR as its own method, instead thinking of it as a workflow/pipeline with PCA as a preprocessor and linear regression as the model.

### SMOTE variants section
In `imbalenced-smote-variants.qmd` (lines 100-107), the "Dimensionaly reduction methods" section lists:
- KMeansSMOTE (K-means + SMOTE)
- SMOTEENN (SMOTE + Edited Nearest Neighbors)
- SMOTETomek (SMOTE + Tomek link removal)

title: Use 2π in the numerator
description:
In the https://feaz-book.com/periodic-trig section, the formulas for converting periodic or cyclical variables into sine and cosine values appear to be missing a 2π factor in the numerator.

When mapping a value x with a known period into a sine or cosine function to preserve cyclical continuity, the standard formula should be:
`sin(2π * x / period)`
